decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game by cycling through cards to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The main strategy is to utilize cards like Astral Slide and Eternal Dragon to repeatedly cycle powerful creatures like Krosan Tusker and Karmic Guide for card advantage and board control. Support cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God help to deal with threats, while cards like Renewed Faith provide essential lifegain. The deck also includes utility cards like Seal of Cleansing and Sterling Grove to deal with problematic enchantments.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of low-cost white creatures, supported by powerful cards like Armageddon and Swords to Plowshares. The creatures in this deck have various abilities that can protect each other, such as protection from specific colors or the ability to prevent damage. This deck aims to control the board early on and maintain an aggressive tempo to quickly defeat the opponent. It also utilizes land destruction and lifegain to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing cycling cards and control elements to stall the opponent and control the board. It aims to continuously cycle through its deck to find key control cards like Wrath of God and Humility, while also generating value through cards like Lightning Rift and Eternal Dragon. The deck has a strong focus on controlling the opponent's creatures and disrupting their game plan, ultimately leading to victory through attrition and card advantage.

The main idea of this deck is to use the Elf tribal synergy to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures. The deck focuses on efficient mana production from cards like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle, as well as card selection and recursion from cards like Survival of the Fittest and Squee, Goblin Nabob. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Biorhythm and Kamahl, Fist of Krosa allows the deck to quickly end the game once it has established a dominant board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with creatures like Fyndhorn Elves and Llanowar Elves, as well as utilizing Gaea's Cradle for additional mana generation. The goal is to flood the board with elves and use cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to untap creatures for extra mana. With the help of Survival of the Fittest, the deck can tutor for key creatures like Deranged Hermit and Kamahl, Fist of Krosa to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive elves.

The deck focuses on using fast and aggressive Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It includes efficient creatures like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Piledriver, as well as powerful support cards like Goblin Warchief and Siege-Gang Commander. The deck also has some disruption with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to slow down the opponent's game plan. Overall, it aims to play creatures quickly, pump them up with lords, and deal damage before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game with efficient removal and disruptive creatures like Meddling Mage, while assembling the combo of Greater Good with Exalted Angel and Lightning Angel to draw cards and generate advantage. The deck also has some protection with cards like Mother of Runes and Silver Knight to keep the combo pieces safe while searching for win conditions. Overall, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent while setting up a powerful combo to close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to establish and maintain control over the game through powerful enchantments and utility cards. By suppressing the opponent's board presence with cards like Humility and Smokestack, while simultaneously building up your own defenses with cards like Worship and Ivory Mask, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until victory can be achieved. The inclusion of efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and versatile creatures like Exalted Angel further adds to the deck's ability to control the game and ensure a favorable outcome.

The deck is centered around using Oath of Druids to cheat out big creatures like Phantom Nishoba. It also includes mana denial cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's resources. The deck aims to control the game through removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and disruptive spells like Sphere of Resistance. The inclusion of cards like Gaea's Blessing and Dust Bowl provides additional utility and resilience against opposing strategies. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around efficiently ramping into powerful threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Oath of Druids card in combination with a variety of enchantments and spells to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck focuses on setting up the Oath of Druids as quickly as possible, while using cards like Frantic Search, Parallax Tide, and Parallax Wave to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By efficiently cycling through your deck and utilizing cards like Replenish and Saproling Burst, you can quickly establish dominance and secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting its opponent's plans and controlling the game through various means such as land denial, hand disruption, and removal spells. The main goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan while establishing control of the board with cards like Winter Orb and Humility. It aims to grind out victories by outlasting the opponent through resource management and strategic decision-making. The deck also includes ways to consistently draw into its key cards and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Gamble and Enlightened Tutor.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using counterspells and removal spells while building card advantage through draw spells. The finisher of the deck is Psychatog, which can grow in power by discarding cards. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, control the board, and ultimately win the game by overwhelming them with the powerful Psychatog. Key strategies include using counterspells to protect Psychatog and using draw spells to find the necessary pieces to secure a victory.

The main concept of this Aggro - Stompy deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures like Llanowar Elves, Quirion Ranger, and River Boa supported by pump spells like Giant Growth and Rancor. The deck also includes Winter Orb to disrupt the opponent's mana development and maintain board control. The deck focuses on early aggression and efficient mana usage to pressure the opponent and win the game quickly before they can stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Druid Lyrist and Elvish Spirit Guide for additional utility and flexibility in gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively ramp up mana with Mox Diamond and Land Tax, while disrupting the opponent with cards like Meddling Mage and Terravore. This leads up to a devastating combo of Armageddon to destroy all lands and quickly close out the game with large threats like Terravore. The deck also includes control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Pyroclasm to handle any opposing threats. The inclusion of cards like Enlightened Tutor and Scroll Rack helps ensure consistency and efficient card draw.

The main idea of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing various removal spells and hand disruption cards. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Plague Spitter while continuously chipping away at the opponent's life total with cards like The Rack and Bottomless Pit. By combining disruptive spells with win conditions that punish the opponent for having a high hand size, the deck seeks to grind out incremental advantages and eventually secure the win.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with madness abilities to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By discarding cards with madness costs and efficiently managing resources, the deck can generate significant card advantage and maintain board presence. The inclusion of counter spells and creature removal adds versatility to the strategy, allowing the player to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through a combination of tempo advantage and efficient, powerful creatures.

The key idea of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, removing threats, and using card advantage to out value the opponent. The deck focuses on efficiently handling the opponent's threats while generating card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction and Impulse. By using a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and board wipes, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while establishing a commanding board presence through cards like Decree of Justice. The deck also utilizes cards like Enlightened Tutor and Parallax Tide to further control the game and slow down the opponent's plans.
